twins: predecessor-drift (the shipped ARH0 and ARH1 validate() implementations run live inside this verifier on every execution; a drifted predecessor population fails here with the drifted node)
hotspot-population-drift (against the ARH1 hotspot contracts and the ARH0 god-module candidates, both directions)
population-count-drift (ARH0 inventory crates/packages, ARH1 hotspot contracts, ARH0 god-module candidates: every committed count equals the live derivation)
structural-loc-drift (recorded fileLoc equals the live line count of each hotspot)
deletion-cutover-row-stale (no shipped product may still bind the deleted path as a path-typed field)
deletion-owner-mismatch (the executing owner of the cutover row is ARH2)
deletion-path-unbound (deletedPath equals the ARH0-DEBT-1 candidate path with the (deleted) marker stripped; an arbitrary absent path is not the executed deletion)
deletion-refresh-population-drift (sameChangeRefresh is exactly the nonempty ARH1-CUT-1 predecessor refresh population)
hotspot-crate-unknown (the lane's crate is a live workspace member)
pin-command-not-canonical (canonical form is cargo nextest run -p <crate> <filter>)
witness-not-a-test (a #[test]/#[tokio::test] attribute must sit by the declaration)

pin-filter-selects-nothing (the filter is a substring of the compiled nextest id from the file's mod/#[path] path plus the witness function's enclosing inline module; a filesystem src:: fragment, a sibling inline module, or a file-level module that does not enclose the function is rejected)
route-characterization-cardinality (every ARH3/ARH4 narrowing cutover row is characterized exactly once before its heir narrows it)

route-surface-drift (the scheduler field items, the pub fn test_* hook population, and the ARH1-CUT-4 bulk retainedTypes/retainedAssocItems/consumersAffected join the ARH1 narrowing populations exactly)
route-surface-not-live (a characterized narrowed field must still be a live pub field: the surface is characterized BEFORE narrowing)
dimension-cardinality (each of the four charter dimensions exactly once)
dimension-commits-wall-clock (no wall-clock/RSS/speedup number may be committed in a dimension row)
dimension-mechanism-kind-mismatch (behavior/test-cost are cargo-nextest, clean/warm is cargo-build, application-latency is a host/session gate-cell)
mechanism-binding-missing (every dimension requires a nonempty mechanisms array)
gate-cell-unknown (every cited mechanism cell is a locked cell of performance-gates.toml)
gate-cell-wrong-operation (application-latency must cite a host/session cell, not a standalone compiler process)
cargo-build-recipe-identity-mismatch (clean and warm recipes must measure the same cargo build targets)
dimension-cache-state-incomplete (clean/warm build time must bind both cache states)
behavior-lane-unbound (every pinned characterization lane is recorded in the behavior dimension)
behavior-lane-invented (every recorded lane is a real pin)
runner-class-unbound (the number policy equals the locked [runner] class)
threshold-block-missing (ARH0-DEBT-5 requires the ratified basis before ARH12 extends the guard)
threshold-ceiling-mismatch (the ratified ceiling equals the live guard ceiling)
threshold-basis-drift (the over-threshold production-file count and the hotspot membership are re-derived live)

candidate-basis-drift (both products pin the same 40-hex commit; verify.mjs --provenance, run by the CI architecture-health lane, additionally proves the pinned commit is a real ancestor of the checked-out head)

notes: Implementation node of the architecture-health train; production footprint is zero beyond the packages/core deletion (ARH1-CUT-1 executed) — the delivered code is this harness and the two products. Behavioral characterization binds existing discriminating cargo nextest lanes (the sole owning interface joining the ARH0/ARH1 products to the live tree) to every ARH1 hotspot responsibility and every narrowing route ARH3/ARH4 own; the lanes are the targeted-domain gate commands and were run green on the reviewed candidate. Complexity measurements separate production behavior, clean/warm build time, test cost and application latency: structural counts are deterministic invariants re-derived live on every run, wall-clock dimensions bind to the locked performance-gates.toml cells on their bound runner class, and no timing number is committed. The god-module threshold basis (33 production files over the live 4000-LOC guard ceiling, five of them the characterized hotspots) ratifies what ARH0-DEBT-5 requires before ARH12 extends the existing guard — no second status system. The predecessor populations are re-derived by running the shipped ARH0/ARH1 verifiers live inside this one. Retained evidence spec: tests/architecture-health/evidence/ARH2/cases.md.
